sources.title: Important Information before a trip: Syria
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Bulgaria
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Bulgarian Foreign Ministry destination page is served over valid TLS, is explicitly scoped to Bulgarian citizens and regular passports, and displays a last update of 10 February 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: It is also possible to obtain a visa upon entry into Syria via a land border.

policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: Syria land-border arrival visa
policies.summary: Bulgaria’s current Foreign Ministry guidance directly states that Bulgarian citizens travelling on regular passports may obtain a Syrian visa upon entry through a land border.
conditions: Applies to a Bulgarian citizen travelling on a regular passport for an ordinary short visit.
The arrival-issued route is limited to entry through a Syrian land border; it does not establish visa issuance at an airport or every entry point.

The same guidance permits advance application at the Syrian Embassy in Sofia and says passports bearing evidence of a visit to Israel are not accepted; work, residence, special documents, security controls and final admission remain outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels the route electronic, while current Bulgarian MFA guidance directly establishes an easier visa issued upon entry at a Syrian land border. The port condition is preserved rather than generalized to air arrival.

unresolved.reason: No reproducible current primary source directly establishes both this ordinary-passport short-visitor nationality and an actual electronic, arrival, advance-mission, exempt or restricted route. Current Syrian sources expose a default advance rule and generic electronic direction but no controlling nationality schedule or terminal eligibility result.
